description.it: Saldo, entrate e uscite mensili del club scelto (dove il gioco le registra).
description.en: Monthly balance, income and expenditure of the chosen club (where the game records them).

widgets.sql: SELECT balance AS value FROM finances WHERE club_uid = :club ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT transfer_budget_remaining AS value FROM finances WHERE club_uid = :club ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT wage_budget_weekly - wage_payroll_weekly AS value FROM finances WHERE club_uid = :club ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT month AS date, balance AS value FROM finances WHERE club_uid = :club ORDER BY month

SELECT month AS date, 'income' AS series, total_income AS value FROM finances WHERE club_uid = :club UNION ALL SELECT month, 'expenditure', total_expenditure FROM finances WHERE club_uid = :club ORDER BY date
